name: hcapp_joinKennel
description: Creates or updates a HasherKennelMap row for a target user at a kennel: follow state, home kennel, membership duration, notification and email preferences, app access flags, mismanagement roles and manual KennelStanding bits. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 50, @param NULL). Permission gates (HC6.CheckKennelPermission in @kennelId): @appAccessFlags / @kennelStandingSet / @kennelStandingClear need 'assignAppAccessFlags'; @mismanagementRoles needs 'assignMismanagementRoles'; editing another user, @monthsToAddToMembership or @paymentAmount needs 'manageMembers'. Self-service (own row, follow / home kennel / preferences only) needs no role — a hasher cannot alter their own membership. After commit, when roles changed, HC.Kennel.KennelMismanagementTeam is rebuilt inline from HC.HasherKennelMap + DomainValues.MismanagementRoles. On success the SP then delegates to hcapp_syncUserData (self) or hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (another user) and streams those rowsets after its own. Sentinel -1 on most parameters means 'keep'. Bit 0x0001 of KennelStanding (the old automated MEMBER bit) is retired since 2026-10-13: membership is MembershipExpirationDate and nothing else, and this SP no longer calls HC6.nonApi_syncMemberStandingBit (dropped). HC.HasherKennelMap.IsMember is still written here but is DEPRECATED (2026-10-13): never read it.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used to resolve the calling userId and DeviceSecret for token validation.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret via HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to join or update. NULL or zero-UUID returns errorCode 1250, errorType 12. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: targetUserId
parameters.description: User whose HKM row is created or updated. Equal to the caller = self-service; different = admin edit, which requires 'manageMembers' and switches the delegate to hcapp_syncKennelAdminData. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: isFollowing
parameters.description: 1=follow, 0 or 2=unfollow (both also clear the home kennel if this is it). -1 is normalised to NULL (keep). Forced to 1 when @isHomeKennel = 1.

parameters.name: isHomeKennel
parameters.description: 1 = make this the home kennel (also sets HC.Hasher.HomeKennelId and clears IsHomeKennel on every other HKM row of the user); 0 = remove the designation. -1 normalised to NULL (keep).

parameters.name: notificationState
parameters.description: Push preference for this kennel. -1 normalised to NULL (keep).

parameters.name: emailAlertState
parameters.description: Email alert preference for this kennel. -1 normalised to NULL (keep).

parameters.name: monthsToAddToMembership
parameters.description: Membership duration control; requires 'manageMembers'. 0 / NULL = no change. 9999 = permanent (expiry 2100-01-01). -9999 = revoke (IsMember 0, expiry NULL, MemberSince NULL). +n = add n months to the current expiry, or from today when expired or new. Also drives IsMember.

parameters.name: appAccessFlags
parameters.description: Permission bitmask; requires 'assignAppAccessFlags'. Written to BOTH AppAccessFlags and HcWebPermissionFlags. -1 normalised to NULL (keep).

parameters.name: mismanagementRoles
parameters.description: Role bitmask; requires 'assignMismanagementRoles'. When set, HC.Kennel.KennelMismanagementTeam is rebuilt. -1 normalised to NULL (keep).

parameters.name: kennelStandingSet
parameters.description: Standing bits to OR in (manual grants such as ALUMNI / TRUSTED / ADMIN); requires 'assignAppAccessFlags'. Applied only on the UPDATE path. Bit 0x0001 (the old automated MEMBER bit) is retired since 2026-10-13.

parameters.name: kennelStandingClear
parameters.description: Standing bits to clear (KennelStanding & ~bits); requires 'assignAppAccessFlags'. Applied only on the UPDATE path.

parameters.name: paymentAmount
parameters.description: Never written anywhere. Its only effect is that a non-NULL value makes the call require 'manageMembers'. Retained for HC5 API compatibility.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for Kennels, passed through to the delegate. NULL is coerced to 'ignore' before the delegate call, but the parameter has no SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for HasherKennelMap, passed through to the delegate. NULL is coerced to 'ignore', but the parameter has no SQL default.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for Hashers, passed through to the delegate. NULL and omitted both become 'ignore'.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always the first rowset. success=1 after the write committed; success=0 on auth failure, missing kennelId (1250/12), not authorised (1337/3) or unhandled CATCH (1950/19).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1250 missing kennelId, 1337 not authorised, 1950 unhandled; auth codes from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 12 validation, 3 not authorised, 19 unhandled; auth types from ValidateAppAuth.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on error only (success=0): standard HC6 app error detail.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: 12 validation, 3 not authorised, 19 unhandled, or the ValidateAppAuth type.

rowsets.name: HkmState
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success only: the HasherKennelMap row immediately after the write (lines 320-328).

columns.name: isHomeKennel
columns.description: 1 if this kennel equals Hasher.HomeKennelId, else 0 — derived from the joined Hasher row, not from HasherKennelMap.IsHomeKennel.

rowsets.name: SyncData
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the pass-through output of hcapp_syncUserData (self) or hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (another user), executed after COMMIT and outside the TRY/CATCH (lines 351-376). Shapes are defined by those contracts.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap when no row exists for (targetUserId, kennelId) — lines 238-253; KennelStanding is NOT set on this path

UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — Following, IsMember, IsHomeKennel, AppAccessFlags, HcWebPermissionFlags, MismanagementRoles, KennelStanding (set/clear bits), KennelNotificationPreference, KennelEmailAlertPreference, MembershipExpirationDate, MemberSince, updatedAt — lines 257-291
UPDATE HC.Hasher SET HomeKennelId = @kennelId (isHomeKennel=1) or NULL (unfollow / isHomeKennel=0 when this was the home kennel)
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET IsHomeKennel=0 on the user's other kennels when isHomeKennel=1
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelMismanagementTeam when @mismanagementRoles is set — rebuilt inline from HC.HasherKennelMap, HC.Hasher and DomainValues.MismanagementRoles (lines 299-314)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing kennelId, not authorised, and unhandled CATCH
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (self) or HC6.hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (another user) after COMMIT

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Standing bits ignored on the INSERT path
codeSmells.detail: @kennelStandingSet / @kennelStandingClear are applied only in the UPDATE branch (lines 272-273). When the call creates the HKM row (lines 238-253) the bits are silently dropped and the row takes the table default, although the caller passed the 'assignAppAccessFlags' gate for them.
@paymentAmount DECIMAL(12,6) is never written; its only effect is tightening the permission gate (line 165). Retained for HC5 callers.

codeSmells.issue: @appAccessFlags silently writes both AppAccessFlags and HcWebPermissionFlags
codeSmells.detail: INSERT (lines 248-249) and UPDATE (lines 266-267) both use @appAccessFlags for HcWebPermissionFlags too. A caller changing app access also overwrites web permissions.
@monthsToAddToMembership: 9999 = permanent (expiry 2100-01-01), -9999 = revoke (IsMember 0, expiry NULL, MemberSince NULL) — lines 259-289. Must never change without updating all callers.

codeSmells.issue: Sync delegate runs outside the transaction and outside TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 351-376 EXEC the sync SP after COMMIT with no TRY/CATCH. A failure there is a raw 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row, after the write has already committed.

codeSmells.issue: IsMember on UPDATE has no explicit 9999 branch
codeSmells.detail: Lines 259-264 handle -9999 and positive months; 9999 falls into the DATEADD comparison (true, so IsMember=1) — correct but implicit.

codeSmells.issue: isHomeKennel output derived from Hasher.HomeKennelId, not HasherKennelMap.IsHomeKennel
codeSmells.detail: Line 325 computes isHomeKennel by joining HC.Hasher. The two columns can disagree if another path updates one without the other.

Only @kennelId is checked (line 118). A NULL @targetUserId skips the 'another user' permission gate (line 163: NULL != @userId is UNKNOWN), finds no HKM row (line 223) and hits the INSERT at line 238 with UserId NULL, which fails the NOT NULL column and surfaces as the generic 1950 unhandled error; line 351 then treats NULL as 'self'. Callers always send it today, but the graceful path is a missing-parameter check, not a constraint violation.

breakingChanges: TRY/CATCH block and XACT_ABORT added — HC5 had no error handling. Unhandled errors now produce the standard error envelope instead of propagating exceptions to the caller.
Success envelope (rowset 0: success/errorCode/errorType) added — HC5 had no such rowset. All rowset indices for existing data are now shifted by 1.
Auth now delegated to HC6.ValidateAppAuth — HC5 performed inline auth. Error codes and types for auth failures may differ.
Delegation targets updated to HC6 SPs: hcapp_syncUserData and hcapp_syncKennelAdminData — HC5 called HC5 equivalents.
HC3.vwMmByKennel dependency removed — the mismanagement team string is now built inline from HC.HasherKennelMap, HC.Hasher and DomainValues.MismanagementRoles.

1.1.0: @kennelStandingSet / @kennelStandingClear added (optional, additive); permission gates added (assignAppAccessFlags / assignMismanagementRoles / manageMembers) — a hasher can no longer set their own membership, flags or roles.
